Name: Simple Journal Expansion
Author: Xsyy
Description:
Simple Journal Expansion
Give your quest journal more room with a taller, two-page book that fits Stardew Valley’s style. Browse more quests at once, with curved paper pages, a stitched leather cover, a sewn centre binding and a ribbon bookmark.
FEATURES
• Two quest-list columns, like an open book.
• Displays up to 18 quests at standard UI scale on a 1920×1080 screen—nine per page.
• Automatically adjusts to your screen size and UI scale.
• Uses a single-page layout in narrow windows.
• Spreads shorter quest lists across both pages.
• Keeps normal paging available for additional quests.
• Improved spacing keeps titles clear of NEW badges and pin controls.
• Long titles wrap or shorten when necessary. Hover over shortened titles to read their full names.
• Matching book styling for quest details.
• Mouse and controller support.
• Supports all 12 built-in game languages.
Open your Journal normally. There are no extra hotkeys or settings to configure.
COMPATIBILITY
Simple Journal Pin
Keeps quest pinning and its journal controls accessible. Pinning requires the separate Simple Journal Pin mod.
Deluxe Journal
Automatically detects Deluxe Journal and expands its Quests page. Tabs sit outside the book, with aligned heading, close and back controls. Tasks, Notes and overlay settings retain their original layouts and content. Compatibility was checked against Deluxe Journal 1.4.1.
Texture themes
The pages use Stardew’s native paper textures and fonts, allowing texture recolours to affect them. The leather cover, binding and bookmark retain their own colours.
This mod changes the journal’s appearance and layout. Quest progress, objectives, rewards and cancellation behave normally.
REQUIREMENTS
• Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later.
• SMAPI 4.4.0 or later.
Simple Journal Pin and Deluxe Journal are optional.
INSTALLATION
Extract the SimpleJournalExpansion folder into your Mods folder.
When updating, replace the existing SimpleJournalExpansion folder.
To uninstall, remove the mod’s folder. No save migration is required.
